items.title: Working Girls, 1931
items.description: "Working Girls" is a unique and amiably daft smile-packed comic melodrama that has been seen by few pre-code movie fans. It was directed by Dorothy Arzner (the only female Hollywood director of the era) with a cast that included Judith Wood, Dorothy Hall, "Buddy" Rogers, Paul Lukas, and Stuart Erwin. The screenplay by Zoë Akins was based on the play “Blind Mice” by Vera Caspary and Winifred Lenihan.
